offence_note: Possession for trafficking, proceeds of crime, unsafe firearm storage
sentence_quote: The total sentence of incarceration is reduced to a total period of 15 years.
note: Delayed parole order quashed; fine in lieu of forfeiture upheld.

offence_note: Trafficking in cocaine ($40 to undercover officer)
sentence_quote: I would substitute a sentence of time served, coupled with the probation order on the existing terms, for the sentence of 6 months
note: Six months reduced to time served (about 7-8 weeks).

offence_note: Two robberies of stores with note and syringe
sentence_quote: I am sentencing you to a period of two years' imprisonment on each count to be served concurrently.
note: Middle of reasons omitted; Gladue weight unclear. Court preferred institution with treatment programs, no firm recommendation.

offence_note: Second degree murder, attempted murder, robbery, firearm use
sentence_quote: In this unusual circumstance I would reduce that period to 10 years and otherwise affirm the sentence.
note: Parole ineligibility cut from 15 to 10 years due to terminal ALS; other terms concurrent as at trial.

offence_note: Five robbery/assault counts and one sexual assault on three women
sentence_quote: we grant leave to appeal the sentence, allow the appeal on the third ground, and reduce the appellant's global sentence to 32 months in custody.
note: 61 months less 29 months credit leaves 32 months, derived from reasons.

offence_note: Robbery, sexual assault, break and enter of elderly woman (dangerous offender)
sentence_quote: It follows I would allow the appeal and order a new hearing.
note: Dangerous offender designation appeal allowed; new hearing ordered.

offence_note: Possession of fentanyl for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: this Court imposes a sentence of 3 years, with credit for 23 months already served prior to sentencing. This leaves 13 months remaining to be served in jail.

offence_note: Possession of loaded prohibited firearm; break and enter
sentence_quote: the sentence imposed below is set aside, and a three year sentence is imposed on the gun offence, and a one year concurrent sentence is imposed on the break and enter, with credit as calculated above for 616 days, leaving 479 days to be served on the gun offence.
note: Crown appeal; illegal conditional sentence replaced by 3 years. Feldman J.A. dissented (no re-incarceration).

offence_note: Jewellery store robbery with alleged imitation gun
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted and the sentence appeal is dismissed.
note: Endorsement gives no offence name or sentence details; offence inferred from store incident.

sentence_quote: I sentence you to a custodial sentence of five years which I convert for Corrections Canada purposes to be 1,825 days.
note: Victim surcharge waived; SOIRA 20 years; no-contact while in custody.
